summary: Module 4 BUILD: profiled the running service with tools, not code reading. Bug #6 (memory/connection leak): tracemalloc probe inside the app process across 1050 requests showed no growing DB-connection objects -- get_db() and analytics helpers already close sessions in finally, so the canonical unclosed-connection leak is absent; the one remaining acquire-without-guaranteed-release pattern was in services/cache.py (aioredis client created per call, aclose() only on happy path). Fixed by moving client close into finally in all three cache functions; probe_conn_leak.py (CLIENT LIST over 5 forced error-path rounds) stays at baseline. Bug #7 (N+1 on /links): SQLAlchemy before_cursor_execute listener proved GET /links?limit=50 fires exactly 3 statements (user, count, page select) -- no per-row analytics queries, so the N+1 pattern is absent. Verification: probe_memory.py flat across 1050 requests, probe_conn_leak.py flat, probe_n1.py 3 statements, full suite 74 tests exit 0.
